title: [v0.92.1][HOT-01] Axum configuration hot reload
body:
## Outcome

Produce one production-ready Axum hot-reload implementation.

## Primary deliverable

One production-ready Axum hot-reload implementation with last-known-good retention.

## Verification result

Valid reload, invalid retention, debounce, concurrent-read, and watcher-shutdown tests pass.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one production-ready hot-reload implementation; behavioral cases are proof inputs.

## Dependencies

- WP-01: #480

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Reads use atomically swappable state
- [ ] Invalid updates preserve the last valid configuration
- [ ] File events are debounced
- [ ] Concurrent requests observe complete configurations only

## Owned paths

- `adl-runtime/src/config_reload.rs`
- `adl-runtime/tests/config_reload.rs`
- `docs/runtime/config-hot-reload.md`

## PVF lanes

- `valid-reload`
- `invalid-retention`
- `debounce`
- `concurrent-read`
- `watcher-shutdown`

## Stop conditions

- Reload requires process restart
- Partial configuration can become visible

## Non-goals

- Database pool replacement
- HTML template reload
- Admin mutation API
